title: Which hooks exist only to make sessions remember, and can filing at once retire them
why: Guards that make a session remember are a backstop. What actually works: anything that matters goes to a lasting home (a repo file, a roadmap page) in the same turn it's said. A session's job is filing, not remembering, so a compaction or a lost session costs nothing. This includes fb: items: tasks and ideas land in the repo's todo, not only the handoff, and each closed item is checked against its home.
